inicial.meta_descricao: Carbono Consciente: dzidzo yezvakatipoteredza pamusoro pekubuda kwekabhoni, tsoka yekabhoni, mazano ekugara zvakanaka, zvinonakidza nenhau dzezvakatipoteredza.

hero.titulo: Tsika diki dzose dzinodzikisa mutoro panyika
hero.texto: CARBONO CONSCIENTE HAISI CHISIMBISO CHEGREEN KANA CHINANGWA CHIRI KURE — NDIKO KUWANDA KWESARUDZO DZEZUVA NEZUVA, DZINODZOKORORWA ZUVA RIMWE NERIMWE: ZVAUNODYARA, MAFAMBIRO AUNOITA, NGUVA YAUNODZIMA MWENJE, UKO KWAUNORASIRA MARARA.

acordeao.emissao_corpo: Kubuda kwekabhoni ndiko kusunungurwa kwemagasi akaita seCO₂ mumhepo, kazhinji nekupisa mafuta emasalu, kutemwa kwemasango, kugadzirwa kwezvinhu mumafekitari, kana kutofambira kwezuva nezuva.
acordeao.clima_corpo: Magasi anokonzera kudziya kwenyika anoumba chinzvimbo chinobata kudziya mumhepo. Kuwanda kwekubuda kwegasi, kunowedzera simba rechinhu ichi — uye ndizvo zvinokonzera kudziya kwenyika pasi rose nekushanduka kwemamiriro ekunze.
acordeao.pegada_corpo: Ndiko kuwanda kwemagasi anokonzera kudziya kwenyika, anogadzirwa, zvakananga kana zvisina kunanga, nezvinoitwa nemunhu, kambani kana chigadzirwa muzuva nezuva rake.
acordeao.neutro_corpo: Kabhoni isina mhosva inotsvaga kuenzanisa kana kudhindira kubuda kwegasi kwakaitwa. Carbono consciente inokoshesa sarudzo dzinodzikisa kukanganisa kwezvakatipoteredza, isati yatombofunga nezvekudhindira.

fatos.fato1: Muti wakura unotora mukati memakore, mukirogiramu anosvika ku22 eCO₂ pagore, ndokusaka kudyarazve miti kuri imwe yenzira dzakananga dzinobatsira kuenzanisa utsi hunobuda.
fatos.fato2: Makungwa anotora kusvika pachikamu chimwe muzvinhu zvina zveCO₂ inobudiswa nevanhu pagore rimwe nerimwe, achishanda sechinhu chikuru chinodzora mamiriro ekunze enyika yose.
fatos.fato3: Kugadziridza tani imwe yepepa kunochengetedza miti inosvika ku17 uye mvura nemagetsi akawanda, kana zvichienzaniswa nekugadzira pepa idzva.
fatos.fato4: Kufamba-famba (transport) ndiko kunokonzera chikamu chimwe muzvina zveCO₂ inobudiswa panyika yose ine chekuita nemagetsi — kuchinja kufamba nemota uchienda nebhasikoro kana transport yepublic parwendo rupfupi kunoita musiyano chaiwo.
fatos.fato5: Sango reAmazon rine zvisikwa zvinosvika pa10% pezvisikwa zvose zvinozivikanwa panyika, uye rinochengeta mabhiriyoni emakarbhoni mumiti yaro.
fatos.fato6: Mapanel ezuva pamba anogona kuderedza utsi hweimba hunosvika patani dzeCO₂ pagore, zvichienderana nekusanganiswa kwemagetsi anoshandiswa munzvimbo iyoyo.
fatos.fato7: Kudya nyama tsvuku shoma kunogona kuderedza zvakanyanya utsi hwemunhu, sezvo kuchengeta mombe kuri chimwe chezvirimo zvinobudisa utsi hwakawandisa.
fatos.fato8: Kunyungudika kwechando mugungwa reArctic kunoderedza masimba enyika okudzorera chiedza chezuva kudenga, zvichimhanyisa kudziya kwenyika — chinhu chinonzi 'albedo feedback'.
fatos.fato9: Mabhandi eLED anoshandisa magetsi mashoma anosvika ku80% kudarika mabhandi akare, uye anogara kwenguva yakareba, achideredza utsi uye marara.
fatos.fato10: Chibvumirano cheParis, chakasainwa nenyika dzinosvika ku200, chine chinangwa chekudzikisira kudziya kwenyika pasi pe2°C pamusoro pemwero wakanga uripo pamberi pemaindasitiri.
fatos.fato11: Chikamu chimwe muzvitatu zvezvokudya zvose zvinogadzirwa panyika zvinoraswa — uye kurasa uku kwoga kunobudisa chikamu chikuru chemagasi anosvibisa mhepo panyika yose.
fatos.fato12: Mapombi emhepo emazuva ano anogona kugadzira magetsi akakwana kupa magetsi kumba dzinosvika muzviuru, pasina kubudisa CO₂ parinenge richishanda.
fatos.fato13: Ivhu rakanaka rinochengeta karbhoni akawanda kudarika zvisikwa zvose nemhepo zvakasanganiswa — mazano ekurima anovandudza ivhu anobatsira kuchengeta karbhoni iyoyo muvhu.
fatos.fato14: Matombo ematanga (coral reefs), kunyangwe achifukidza pasi pe1% pasi pegungwa, anotsigira zvinosvika ku25% pezvipenyu zvose zvegungwa zvinozivikanwa — uye anonzwa kunyanya kudziya kwemvura.
fatos.fato15: Kuderedza kurasa mvura inopisa mumba (semuenzaniso, kugezera nguva pfupi) kunodzorawo utsi, sezvo kudziisa mvura kuchishandisa magetsi.
fatos.fato16: Mota dzemagetsi, kunyangwe tichifunga nezvekugadzirwa kwebhatiri, dzinowanzobudisa CO₂ shoma mukati meupenyu hwadzo kudarika mota dzinoshandisa mafuta, kunyanya kana magetsi achibva kuzvinhu zvisina kusvibisa.
fatos.fato17: Kuita compost yemarara anobva kuzvipenyu mumba kunodzivirira kubudiswa kwegasi remethane kunzvimbo dzinoiswa marara — gasi rinonyanya kusvibisa mhepo kudarika CO₂ panguva pfupi.
fatos.fato18: Chando cheGreenland neAntarctica pamwe chinorasikirwa, mumakore apfuura, nemazana emabhiriyoni etani dzechando pagore, zvichibatsira zvakananga mukukwira kwemvura yegungwa.
